text:
maria: Customer deploy to Vercel Edge failed: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @redwood/inference-sdk@0.12.3
aditya: Can you share the package manifest from their node_modules?
maria: Pack manifest shows: {"main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs","exports":{".":{"require":"dist/index.cjs","import":"dist/index.cjs.mjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"} — note the import points to dist/index.cjs.mjs
sophie: That double-extension is our bug from the publish transform. ESM resolver looks for exact path and fails.
aditya: Short-term: republish 0.12.4 with exports import -> ./dist/index.mjs, require -> ./dist/index.cjs and include types + sourcemaps. Deprecate 0.12.3.
sophie: Long-term: add a release validation that runs npm pack and verifies every path referenced in package.json (main/module/exports/types) exists in tarball; fail CI if missing or suspicious patterns (*.cjs.mjs). Also add a lint to detect double extensions in dist.
maria: Workaround for affected customer: import deep path '@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/index.mjs' until we republish.
build-bot: Release check: tarball missing ["dist/index.mjs","dist/index.d.ts"] and unexpected file ["dist/index.cjs.mjs"]. Publish blocked.
aditya: I'll build patched artifacts and publish canary after PR. Sophie, can you own the CI check PR?
sophie: On it. I'll also add a release note to run npm pack locally and inspect with tar -tf.
maria: Closing loop when 0.12.4 is published and deprecation posted. :thumbsup:
